// segenc: tiny libvpx VP9 encoder driver that exercises segmentation features
// the stock ffmpeg/vpxenc command lines cannot reach: the ROI map
// (VP9E_SET_ROI_MAP: per-segment ALT_Q, ALT_LF, SKIP and REF_FRAME features)
// and the active map (VP8E_SET_ACTIVEMAP: SKIP + ALT_LF=-63 on segment 7).
//
// build: cp segment_segenc.c.txt segenc.c &&
//        cc -O1 -o segenc segenc.c $(pkg-config --cflags --libs vpx)
// usage: segenc W H FRAMES BITS KBPS FP in.yuv out.ivf roi DQ DLF SKIP REF MOVE [OFF0 OFF1]
//        segenc W H FRAMES BITS KBPS FP in.yuv out.ivf active MOVE
//   BITS   8 (profile 0, input yuv420p) or 10 (profile 2, input yuv420p10le)
//   FP     frame-parallel decoding mode (0/1)
//   DQ, DLF, SKIP, REF   8 comma-separated ints, one per segment (REF: -1 none,
//          0 intra, 1 last, 2 golden)
//   MOVE   the map pattern is shifted by MOVE*frame 8x8 columns each frame
//   OFF0 OFF1  frames OFF0 <= f < OFF1 are coded with the ROI map removed
//          (segmentation disabled), the map keeps moving meanwhile
// ROI map: 4x2 grid of segments 0..7 over the frame (8x8 units).
// Active map: an inactive rectangle in the middle of the frame (16x16 units).
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <vpx/vp8cx.h>
#include <vpx/vpx_encoder.h>

static void die(const char *m) {
  fprintf(stderr, "segenc: %s\n", m);
  exit(1);
}
static void le16(FILE *f, unsigned v) {
  fputc(v & 255, f);
  fputc((v >> 8) & 255, f);
}
static void le32(FILE *f, unsigned v) {
  le16(f, v & 0xffff);
  le16(f, v >> 16);
}
static void parse8(const char *s, int out[8]) {
  if (sscanf(s, "%d,%d,%d,%d,%d,%d,%d,%d", &out[0], &out[1], &out[2], &out[3],
             &out[4], &out[5], &out[6], &out[7]) != 8)
    die("need 8 comma-separated ints");
}
static int drain(vpx_codec_ctx_t *c, FILE *out) {
  vpx_codec_iter_t it = NULL;
  const vpx_codec_cx_pkt_t *p;
  int n = 0;
  while ((p = vpx_codec_get_cx_data(c, &it)) != NULL) {
    if (p->kind != VPX_CODEC_CX_FRAME_PKT) continue;
    le32(out, (unsigned)p->data.frame.sz);
    le32(out, (unsigned)p->data.frame.pts);
    le32(out, 0);
    fwrite(p->data.frame.buf, 1, p->data.frame.sz, out);
    n++;
  }
  return n;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
  if (argc < 11) die("bad usage");
  int w = atoi(argv[1]), h = atoi(argv[2]), frames = atoi(argv[3]);
  int bits = atoi(argv[4]), kbps = atoi(argv[5]), fp = atoi(argv[6]);
  FILE *in = fopen(argv[7], "rb"), *out = fopen(argv[8], "wb");
  const char *mode = argv[9];
  int is_roi = !strcmp(mode, "roi");
  int dq[8], dlf[8], skip[8], ref[8], move, off0 = -1, off1 = -1;
  if (!in || !out) die("open");
  if (is_roi) {
    if (argc != 15 && argc != 17) die("roi needs DQ DLF SKIP REF MOVE");
    parse8(argv[10], dq);
    parse8(argv[11], dlf);
    parse8(argv[12], skip);
    parse8(argv[13], ref);
    move = atoi(argv[14]);
    if (argc == 17) {
      off0 = atoi(argv[15]);
      off1 = atoi(argv[16]);
    }
  } else {
    move = atoi(argv[10]);
  }

  vpx_codec_enc_cfg_t cfg;
  vpx_codec_ctx_t c;
  if (vpx_codec_enc_config_default(vpx_codec_vp9_cx(), &cfg, 0)) die("cfg");
  cfg.g_w = w;
  cfg.g_h = h;
  cfg.g_timebase.num = 1;
  cfg.g_timebase.den = 30;
  cfg.g_threads = 1;
  cfg.g_lag_in_frames = 0;
  cfg.g_error_resilient = 0;
  cfg.rc_end_usage = VPX_CBR;
  cfg.rc_target_bitrate = kbps;
  cfg.kf_mode = VPX_KF_AUTO;
  cfg.kf_max_dist = 9999;
  cfg.rc_min_quantizer = 8;
  cfg.rc_max_quantizer = 56;
  if (bits > 8) {
    cfg.g_profile = 2;
    cfg.g_bit_depth = VPX_BITS_10;
    cfg.g_input_bit_depth = 10;
  }
  if (vpx_codec_enc_init(&c, vpx_codec_vp9_cx(), &cfg,
                         bits > 8 ? VPX_CODEC_USE_HIGHBITDEPTH : 0))
    die("init");
  vpx_codec_control(&c, VP8E_SET_CPUUSED, 6);
  vpx_codec_control(&c, VP9E_SET_AQ_MODE, 0);
  vpx_codec_control(&c, VP9E_SET_FRAME_PARALLEL_DECODING, fp);
  vpx_codec_control(&c, VP9E_SET_TILE_COLUMNS, 0);

  vpx_image_t img;
  if (!vpx_img_alloc(&img, bits > 8 ? VPX_IMG_FMT_I42016 : VPX_IMG_FMT_I420, w,
                     h, 1))
    die("img");
  int bps = bits > 8 ? 2 : 1;
  int mi_cols = (w + 7) / 8, mi_rows = (h + 7) / 8;
  int mb_cols = (w + 15) / 16, mb_rows = (h + 15) / 16;
  unsigned char *map = malloc((size_t)mi_cols * mi_rows);

  le32(out, 0x46494b44);  // "DKIF"
  le16(out, 0);
  le16(out, 32);
  le32(out, 0x30395056);  // "VP90"
  le16(out, w);
  le16(out, h);
  le32(out, 30);
  le32(out, 1);
  le32(out, frames);
  le32(out, 0);

  int n = 0;
  for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
    for (int p = 0; p < 3; p++) {
      int pw = p ? (w + 1) / 2 : w, ph = p ? (h + 1) / 2 : h;
      for (int y = 0; y < ph; y++)
        if (fread(img.planes[p] + (size_t)y * img.stride[p], bps, pw, in) !=
            (size_t)pw)
          die("short input");
    }
    if (is_roi) {
      vpx_roi_map_t roi;
      memset(&roi, 0, sizeof(roi));
      for (int r = 0; r < mi_rows; r++)
        for (int x = 0; x < mi_cols; x++) {
          int xx = (x + move * f) % mi_cols;
          map[r * mi_cols + x] =
              (unsigned char)(xx * 4 / mi_cols + 4 * (r * 2 / mi_rows));
        }
      roi.enabled = 1;
      roi.roi_map = map;
      roi.rows = mi_rows;
      roi.cols = mi_cols;
      if (f >= off0 && f < off1) {
        memset(roi.ref_frame, -1, sizeof(roi.ref_frame));
      } else {
        memcpy(roi.delta_q, dq, sizeof(dq));
        memcpy(roi.delta_lf, dlf, sizeof(dlf));
        memcpy(roi.skip, skip, sizeof(skip));
        memcpy(roi.ref_frame, ref, sizeof(ref));
      }
      if (vpx_codec_control(&c, VP9E_SET_ROI_MAP, &roi)) die("roi");
    } else {
      vpx_active_map_t am;
      for (int r = 0; r < mb_rows; r++)
        for (int x = 0; x < mb_cols; x++) {
          int xx = (x + move * f) % mb_cols;
          int inactive = xx >= mb_cols / 4 && xx < mb_cols * 3 / 4 &&
                         r >= mb_rows / 4 && r < mb_rows * 3 / 4;
          map[r * mb_cols + x] = !inactive;
        }
      am.active_map = map;
      am.rows = mb_rows;
      am.cols = mb_cols;
      if (vpx_codec_control(&c, VP8E_SET_ACTIVEMAP, &am)) die("activemap");
    }
    if (vpx_codec_encode(&c, &img, f, 1, 0, VPX_DL_REALTIME)) die("encode");
    n += drain(&c, out);
  }
  if (vpx_codec_encode(&c, NULL, -1, 1, 0, VPX_DL_REALTIME)) die("flush");
  n += drain(&c, out);
  fseek(out, 24, SEEK_SET);
  le32(out, n);
  fclose(out);
  fprintf(stderr, "segenc: %d packets\n", n);
  return 0;
}
